name: cursor-remote
description: Cursor-like web chat. The VPS gateway runs Cursor SDK against a local workspace.

scripts.dev: PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH concurrently -n web,gateway -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w gateway"
scripts.build: PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH npm run build -w web && PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH npm run build -w gateway
scripts.start: PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH concurrently -n web,gateway -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w web" "npm run start -w gateway"
scripts.check:protocol: diff shared/protocol.ts web/lib/protocol.ts && echo 'protocol 双份同步 ✅'
scripts.ci: npm run check:protocol && npm run build -w gateway && npm run ci:smoke && npm run build -w web
scripts.ci:smoke: npm run smoke:assistant -w gateway && npm run smoke:turnfiles -w gateway && npm run smoke:loops -w gateway && npm run smoke:apns -w gateway && npm run smoke:native -w gateway && npm run smoke:publish -w gateway && bash scripts/ci-gateway-smoke.sh
